notes: Published-line 0.4.1 is a patch on 0.4.0. Real-data tests against a target at a private or loopback address quote and run once target verify confirmed it from this machine with the connector challenge (AUG-399). test --assessment and test --manifest on a saved real-data suite read its execution scope from the revision the server returns, so the quote and run carry the scope's target boundary (AUG-402). After a hard kill between uploading a result and saving its acknowledgement, the CLI re-sends the saved completion instead of running the operation again, and recover --retire, recover --resume, recover --cancel and a new test re-send it before releasing a finished run; a command that never completed and a prepared fixture still awaiting cleanup are recorded as abandoned, with a warning for the fixture (AUG-404). Relay polls and run-status reads retry network errors, 408, 429 and 5xx responses, waiting at least the server's Retry-After with capped exponential backoff, until the run deadline; sequences the server lists in skipped_sequences are journaled as skipped instead of failing with COMMAND_SEQUENCE_GAP; and runner, test and recover --json errors carry run_id (AUG-412). A cancelled run waits up to five minutes for its cleanup commands (AUG-405). A partial evaluation with every judge job done is a finished, inconclusive assessment: test, run wait, run status and run report exit 10 instead of waiting, and a failed attempt with no reply is not an evidence gap (AUG-403). Email and phone redaction rules reach every text field under the selected node, and the phone detector matches international numbers (AUG-400). It keeps the 0.4.0 Node.js 22.12 minimum (engines.node >=22.12; Node.js 20 reached end of life in April 2026, and npm 0.3.9 stays the last version for Node.js 20) and hosted authorized real-data testing: target add, target verify, target list, target pull, and scope create register and verify a workspace target and write its test scope into an aw-suite/3 file, and authorized hosted runs quote and create with the scope's registered boundary hash after checking augmentworks.yaml against that boundary. It reads the server's real-data documents as aw-real-data/1 defines them, vendored from main 16d767967c9d000b81f10ddb09800b0273277b68 with releaseEnabled and runtimeEnforced true. gate reads the server's aw-release-gate-read/1 decision, compare reads aw-semantic-comparison-read/1, test and run wait take pass or fail from the graded run report, baseline promote sends runId, and baseline create makes a workspace's first pin. It also keeps the 0.3.9 hosted run-scope lookup hardening (AUG-335), the 0.3.8 report consistency check (AUG-272), and the saved-suite customer path: native aw-customer-suite/1 upload translation, saved-suite v2 binding, authoritative v2 whole-suite gate receipts, durable execution IDs, cross-shard quote/run uniqueness, and non-destructive generated .env guidance. Generated and documented npx commands pin this package version (0.4.1). published_package_verified is published-line identity (not a candidate), not a live registry probe of this exact tarball.
